_doc: World events (LW-001, WorldEvents). At every month boundary each event that is not already under way starts with probability monthly_chance in one region picked at random from `regions` (regions.json ids), lasting a random min_days..max_days. start_text/end_text are logged when it starts and ends ({region} = the region's name). modifiers apply in that region while it lasts: encounter_tags (extra encounters.json tags added to every exploration there, so events can have their own encounters), price_mult (multiplies what merchants there charge), qi_density (multiplies cultivation there). Active events are saved with the game. Optional `tournament` (LW-003): {rounds, prize: {items, manuals, reputation}} lets the player enter a bracket of `rounds` non-lethal spars in a row against generated cultivators of their own realm (each a stage tougher, no healing between); a win pays `prize.items` ({item_id: n}), one random manual from `prize.manuals` (items.json ids) and `prize.reputation` with the player's sect. Optional `defence`: {enemy, effects} lets the player beat one raider (enemies.json id, scaled to the player's realm and stage) for `effects` (shared Effects keys). Each can be done once per event instance. Optional `months` (WE-002): list of month numbers 1-12 (Calendar.month_of) in which the event may start; with monthly_chance 1.0 and one month it is a yearly fixed-date event. Optional `festival`: true marks a festival (journal line, UI). Optional `shop_items` (FEST-002): item ids (known, price > 0) the region's merchants also sell while the event lasts (shown last, marked (festival), at merchants whose stock_tags meet `stall_tags` or who have none (FEST-004); festival goods ignore the merchant's max_price (they are cheap); give them no merchant tags so ordinary merchants never stock them). Optional `stall_tags` (FEST-004): non-empty list of item tags naming the stalls that carry shop_items (default ["herb"]). Optional `activity` (FEST-003, meant for festivals): {name, text, days >= 0, effects (shared Effects keys), bonus?: {attribute (attributes.json id), min, text, effects}}; anyone (mortals too) can take part once per event instance, taking `days` of time and applying `effects`; `bonus` text and effects are added when the attribute is at least `min`. Optional `contest` (FEST-006, festivals): once a year per festival the player may enter {name, text, attribute (attributes.json id; score = attribute + 1d11-1), profession? (professions.json id; +2 per rank), rivals 2..4 (villagers of the region, strangers if too few), prizes: 1..3 entries for 1st..3rd place {items?, favor_all? 0..5 (favor with every villager of the region), renown? 0..5}, win_text, lose_text ({winner} allowed)}; ties go to the player. FEST-007: champion_greeting (required, {player} allowed) is what last year's villager winner says; that villager always enters and scores +2; the winner is kept in world flag contest_winner_<event_id> {year, name, you, streak}; three wins in a row set contest_master_<event_id>. modifiers.favor_mult (>= 1.0) multiplies the favor gained from chatting and gifts in that region (before the usual caps).

events.name: Beast Tide
events.description: Spirit beasts pour out of the deep wilds in a maddened tide, trampling everything in their path.
events.start_text: A beast tide boils out of the deep wilds of {region}! Hunters and fools rush in.
events.end_text: The beast tide in {region} ebbs away into the wilds.

events.name: Sect Tournament
events.description: The great sects hold an open tournament. Rogue cultivators and disciples alike test themselves in the ring for prizes and fame.
events.start_text: The great sects open a tournament in {region}. Any cultivator may enter the ring.
events.end_text: The tournament in {region} ends; the stands empty and the banners come down.

events.name: Auction Season
events.description: Collectors from across the realm descend on the markets. Prices soar, but rare goods change hands in every alley.
events.start_text: Auction season begins in {region}: merchants raise their prices as collectors flood the streets.
events.end_text: Auction season in {region} is over, and prices settle back down.

events.name: Demonic Incursion
events.description: Blood-path cultivators raid the land in force, harvesting the weak. Their slaughter fouls the spiritual qi.
events.start_text: A demonic incursion! Blood-path cultivators descend on {region}, and the air turns heavy with the smell of blood.
events.end_text: The demonic cultivators withdraw from {region}, leaving burned homes behind.

events.name: Qingming Ancestor Festival
events.description: In the clear, bright days of spring the mountain's disciples sweep the graves of the departed, burn paper offerings and share cold dumplings, remembering those who walked the Dao before them.
events.start_text: Incense smoke curls over the graves of {region}. The Qingming Ancestor Festival has begun.
events.end_text: The paper offerings have burned to ash at {region}; the Qingming Ancestor Festival is over.

activity.name: Sweep the ancestors' graves
activity.text: You take a bamboo broom up the hillside and sweep the old graves clean, lay down a few dumplings and bow to names no one remembers. The mountain feels quieter afterwards.

bonus.text: Between the incense and the wind you hear a faint whisper from the departed, a half-remembered breath-counting rhyme that steadies your dantian.

contest.name: Kite flying on the ridge
contest.champion_greeting: Still holding your kite string like a sword, {player}? The wind is mine this year.
contest.text: Disciples launch paper kites from the ridge; whoever keeps theirs aloft longest in the gusting wind takes the ribbon.
contest.win_text: Your kite rides the wind long after the rest have fallen; the elders tie the ribbon to your wrist.
contest.lose_text: {winner}'s kite stays up past yours, and the ridge cheers.

events.name: Dragon Boat Festival
events.description: In the heat of midsummer the villagers carve a dragon-prowed boat, drum the river awake and toss rice dumplings to the water so the fish will leave the old poets alone.
events.start_text: Drums boom along the river at {region}, and a dragon-prowed boat noses out from the reeds. The Dragon Boat Festival has begun.
events.end_text: The drums fall quiet at {region}; the dragon boat is hauled ashore and the Dragon Boat Festival is over.

activity.name: Row the dragon boat
activity.text: You take a place on the long bench between two farmers and pull to the drummer's beat until your shoulders burn and the whole river seems to row with you.

bonus.text: Your stroke never falters, and the steady heat of the pull settles into your bones like a second dantian.

contest.name: Dragon boat race
contest.text: Crews of villagers race their boats to the far bank; the strongest back at the oar carries the day.
contest.win_text: Your boat noses over the line first, and the drummer throws down his sticks and whoops.
contest.lose_text: {winner}'s crew pulls ahead in the last stretch and the bank erupts in cheers.

events.name: Mid-Autumn Moon Festival
events.description: When the harvest moon is fullest, the market's traders hang lanterns from every stall, cut moon cakes for strangers and haggle with a lighter heart.
events.start_text: Round lanterns glow above every stall at {region}. The Mid-Autumn Moon Festival has begun.
events.end_text: The moon wanes over {region}; the Mid-Autumn Moon Festival is over.

activity.name: Moon-viewing on the market roof
activity.text: You climb a ladder to the roof of the tallest stall, where traders pass wine and watch the harvest moon rise over the lanterns. The pale light pools in your dantian.

bonus.text: Your easy talk draws a stranger from the next roof, who presses a moon cake into your hands and drinks to your health.

contest.name: Moon-cake judging
contest.champion_greeting: Come to be humbled again, {player}? My tongue has not forgotten a single filling.
contest.text: Stall-holders set out moon cakes; guess the fillings by taste alone and the market names its sharpest tongue.
contest.win_text: You name every filling, down to the pinch of osmanthus; the traders crown you with a paper moon.
contest.lose_text: {winner} names one filling more than you, and the stalls roar.

events.name: Lantern Festival
events.description: On the first nights of winter the village floats paper lanterns down the river and burns incense for the ancestors. Strangers are fed and old grudges are set aside.
events.start_text: Paper lanterns drift down the river at {region}, and villagers burn incense for the ancestors. The Lantern Festival has begun.
events.end_text: The last lanterns burn out on the river at {region}; the Lantern Festival is over.

activity.name: Float a lantern
activity.text: You write a name on a paper lantern and set it on the river with the villagers. It drifts away among a hundred others.

bonus.text: Watching the lights follow the current, something about how qi finds its way settles in you.

contest.name: Lantern riddles
contest.champion_greeting: Back for the red lantern, {player}? I have been saving my best riddles for you.
contest.text: Riddles hang from the lanterns along the river; the villagers race to answer the most before the candles gutter.
contest.win_text: The old riddle-master hands you the red lantern: no one has answered so many in years.
contest.lose_text: {winner} answers the last riddle before you and laughs as the crowd cheers.

events.name: Spirit Qi Tide
events.description: The earth's dragon veins surge. Spiritual qi thickens until even mortals can feel it on their skin.
events.start_text: The dragon veins beneath {region} surge: a spirit qi tide thickens the air with qi!
events.end_text: The spirit qi tide in {region} subsides.
